The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d94e973e689e60b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 81. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The Gaussian observables in the problem have all their stated ordered limits, at every u > 0 and s > 0, and are given by GJ (u) = P(0 < H1 ≤ u), FJ (s) = P  R αcc ≤ s R > 0  . (8.16) The force law has mean one and no atom at zero. These limiting laws are also the laws for all Gaussian scale mixtures in the fixed-temperature comparison range. More explicitly, for every 0 < δ < u and s > 0, the individual limits at each level of lim α↓αc lim β→∞ lim N→∞ GN,β,α(δ, u) = P(δ < H1 ≤ u), lim α↓αc lim β→∞ lim N→∞ FN,β,α(s) = FJ (s) exist; the additional limit δ ↓ 0 in the first line gives GJ (u).
